How to get attributes of viewer preference and values of metadata in a PDF file.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

NSString *kMetadataItems[8] = {@"Title", @"Author", @"Subject", @"Keywords", @"Creator", @"Producer", @"CreationDate", @"ModDate"};

void ShowMetaDataInfo(FSPDFDoc *doc) {
 FSMetadata *metadata = [[FSMetadata alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 for (unsigned int i = 0; i < sizeof(kMetadataItems) / sizeof(kMetadataItems[0]); i++) {
 NSString *item = kMetadataItems[i];
 NSArray<NSString *> *value = [metadata getValues:item];
 }
}

const FSPDFDocDisplayMode kDisplayModes[6] = {FSPDFDocDisplayUseNone, FSPDFDocDisplayUseOutlines, FSPDFDocDisplayUseThumbs, FSPDFDocDisplayFullScreen, FSPDFDocDisplayUseOC, FSPDFDocDisplayUseAttachment};

NSString *kDisplayModeStrings[6] = {@"UseNone", @"UseOutlines", @"UseThumbs", @"FullScreen", @"UseOC", @"UseAttachment"};

NSString *GetViewerPrefPrintScaleName(FSDocViewerPrefsPrintScale ui_item) {
 switch (ui_item) {
 case FSDocViewerPrefsPrintScaleNone:
 return @"PrintScaleNone";
 case FSDocViewerPrefsPrintScaleAppDefault:
 return @"PrintScaleAppDefault";
 default:
 return @"";
 }
}

void ShowDocViewerPrefsInfo(FSPDFDoc *doc) {
 content = @"";
 FSDocViewerPrefs *prefs = [[FSDocViewerPrefs alloc] initWithDocument:doc pdf_dict:NULL];

 // Get display mode for non full-screen mode.
 FSPDFDocDisplayMode mode = prefs.nonFullScreenPageMode;
 NSString *display_mode = @"";
 for (unsigned int i = 0; i < sizeof(kDisplayModes) / sizeof(kDisplayModes[i]); i++) {
 if (mode == kDisplayModes[i]) {
 display_mode = kDisplayModeStrings[i];
 break;
 }
 }

 // Get reading direction.
 bool is_rtl = prefs.readingDirection;

 // Get the type of area item.
 FSPDFPageBoxType type = prefs.printClip;

 // Get page scaling option.
 GetViewerPrefPrintScaleName(prefs.printScale)

 // Get the number of copies to be printed.
 int copy = prefs.printCopies
}

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 NSString *input_file = [[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"%@%@", input_path, @"AboutFoxit.pdf"];
 NSFileManager *fileManager = [NSFileManager defaultManager];
 BOOL isDir = NO;
 if ([fileManager fileExistsAtPath:output_directory isDirectory:&isDir]) {
 if (!isDir) {
 NSError *error = nil;
 if (![fileManager removeItemAtPath:output_directory error:&error] || error) {
 return -1;
 }
 if (![fileManager createDirectoryAtPath:output_directory withIntermediateDirectories:YES attributes:nil error:&error] || error) {
 return -1;
 }
 }
 } else {
 NSError *error = nil;
 if (![fileManager createDirectoryAtPath:output_directory withIntermediateDirectories:YES attributes:nil error:&error] || error) {
 return -1;
 }
 }

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Library Initialize Error: %ld", errorCode);
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"The Doc [%@] Error: %ld\n", input_file, errorCode);
 return 1;
 }
 // Show original information.
 ShowDocViewerPrefsInfo(doc, @"original.txt");
 ShowMetaDataInfo(doc, @"original.txt");
 NSString *output_file = [[NSString alloc] initWithFormat:@"%@%@", output_directory, @"AboutFoxit_docinfo.pdf"];
 [doc saveAs:output_file save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *exception) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", exception);
 return -1;
 }
 }
 return 0;
}

Customize to hide top/bottom toolbar

In the top/bottom toolbar (See Figure 52), you can do the following operations:
1.Show or hide the top/bottom toolbar.
2.Show or hide a specific item in the top/bottom toolbar.
3.Remove a specific tab in the center of the top toolbar.
4.Add a custom item at any position.

Note:
1.For iPad device, it has removed the bottom toolbar.
2.For iPhone device, the bottom toolbar is only one part, and the top toolbar is divided into two parts, so that there are three parts for the toolbar, and each part has a separate index. For iPad device, it has no bottom toolbar.
Table 51 lists the related APIs which are used to customize the top/bottom toolbar.

Tists the related APIs which are used to customize the top/bottom toolbar.

```objc
- [UIExtensionsManager enableTopToolbar:(BOOL)isEnabled];	//Enable or disable top toolbar.
- [UIExtensionsManager enableBottomToolbar:(BOOL)isEnabled];	//Enable or disable bottom toolbar.
- [UIExtensionsManager setToolbarItemHiddenWithTag:(FS_TOOLBAR_ITEM_TAG)itemTag hidden:(BOOL)isHidden];	//Show or hide the item in the top/bottom toolbar
```

The value of the parameter "itemTag" in setToolbarItemHiddenWithTag interface can be set as follows, which maps the features in the top/bottom toolbar.

```
FS_TOOLBAR_ITEM_TAG_BACK
FS_TOOLBAR_ITEM_TAG_SEARCH
FS_TOOLBAR_ITEM_TAG_MORE
FS_TOOLBAR_ITEM_TAG_HOME
FS_TOOLBAR_ITEM_TAG_EDIT
FS_TOOLBAR_ITEM_TAG_COMMENT
FS_TOOLBAR_ITEM_TAG_DRAWING
FS_TOOLBAR_ITEM_TAG_FORM
FS_TOOLBAR_ITEM_TAG_SIGN
FS_TOOLBAR_ITEM_TAG_PANEL
FS_TOOLBAR_ITEM_TAG_VIEW / FS_TOOLBAR_ITEM_TAG_VIEW_SETTINGS
FS_TOOLBAR_ITEM_TAG_THUMBNAIL
FS_TOOLBAR_ITEM_TAG_READING_BOOKMARK
```

How can I set whether to highlight the form fields in PDF form files? And how to set the highlight color if I want to highlight form fields?

By default, highlighting form fields in PDF documents is enabled. If you want to set the highlight color, please make sure you have not disabled the highlighting form fields feature.
From version 6.3, you can disable/enable highlighting form fields or set the highlight color easily in the configuration JSON file, just set the following two items:
"highlightForm": true,
"highlightFormColor": "#200033cc",
For the version before 6.3, if you want to disable/enable highlighting form fields or set the highlight color, you should modify the source code of the UI Extensions Component using `-[FSFormFiller highlightFormFields:]` and `-[FSFormFiller setHighlightColor:]` interfaces.
`-[FSFormFiller highlightFormFields:]` interface is provided to set whether to enable highlighting the form fields in PDF form files. Please refer to section 4.3 "Customize UI implementation through source code" to add the "uiextensions" project found in the "libs/uiextensions_src" folder to your project. Then, find the onDocOpened function in "UIExtensions/Form/FormAnnotHandler.m", and set the parameter of `-[FSFormFiller highlightFormFields:]` to "false" as follows:

```objc
- (void)onDocOpened:(FSPDFDoc* )document error:(int)error
{
	...
	...

	[_formFiller highlightFormFields:false];
}

```
`-[FSFormFiller setHighlightColor:]`interface is used to set the highlight color. Following is a sample for calling this API:

```objc
- (void)onDocOpened:(FSPDFDoc* )document error:(int)error
{
	...
	...

	[_formFiller highlightFormFields:ture];
	[_formFiller setHighlightColor:0x4b00ff00];
}
```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add associate files into marked content.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 // Associate files with objects in PDF documents.
 NSString* input_file = @"AssociateTestFile.pdf";
 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"The Doc [%@] Error: %ld\n", input_file, errorCode);
 return -1;
 }

 FSAssociatedFiles *associated_files = [[FSAssociatedFiles alloc] initWithPdf_doc:doc];

 // Create filespec with 2.jpg image.
 FSFileSpec *filespec_jpg = [[FSFileSpec alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 filespec_jpg.associteFileRelationship = FSAssociatedFilesRelationshipSource;
 filespec_jpg.fileName = @"2.jpg";
 filespec_jpg.description = @"jpeg";
 [filespec_jpg embed:[input_path stringByAppendingString:@"2.jpg"]];
 filespec_jpg.creationDateTime = dateTime;
 filespec_jpg.modifiedDateTime = dateTime;

 // Associate 2.jpg with marked content.
 {
 FSPDFDictionary *page_dict = [page getDict];
 FSPDFDictionary *resource_dict = (FSPDFDictionary *) [page_dict getElement:@"Resources"];
 if (resource_dict == nil)
 return 1;

 long position = [page getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition:FSGraphicsObjectTypeText];
 FSGraphicsObject *text_object = [page getGraphicsObject:position];
 if (text_object != nil) {
 FSMarkedContent *markcontent = [text_object getMarkedContent];
 if (markcontent == nil)
 return 1;
 if ([markcontent getItemCount] == 0)
 [markcontent addItem:@"Associated" property_dict:NULL];
 [associated_files associateFileWithGraphicsObject:text_object mark_content_item_index:0 current_resource:resource_dict property_name:@"textobject" file_spec:filespec_jpg];
 [page generateContent];

 }
 }
 // Save PDF file
 [doc saveAs:@"associated_files.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

What is Bitcode? Does Foxit PDF SDK for iOS support Bitcode?

Bitcode is an intermediate representation of a compiled binary. Including bitcode will allow Apple to re-optimize your app binary in the future without the need to submit a new version of your app to the store.
Yes. Foxit PDF SDK for iOS supports Bitcode since version 3.0.

---

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to get annotation rectangle in device coordinate system.

```objective-c
#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Library Initialize Error: %ld", errorCode);
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString* input_pdf_name = @"input_file.pdf";
 // Load a document
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_name];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 FSPDFPage* page = [doc getPage:0];
 int width = (int)[page getWidth];
 int height = (int)[page getHeight];
 NSArray *bmpWidth = @[@(width), @(2 * width)];
 NSArray *bmpHeight = @[@(height), @(2 * height)];

 for (NSInteger i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
 FSMatrix2D *setMatrix = [page getDisplayMatrix:0 y:0 width:bmpWidth[i] height:bmpHeight[i] rotation:FSRotation0];
 NSInteger iAnnotCount = [page getAnnotCount];

 for (NSInteger j = 0; j < iAnnotCount; j++) {
 FSAnnot* pAnnot = [page getAnnot:j];
 FSRectI* deviceRect = [pAnnot getDeviceRect:setMatrix];
 }
 }
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 }
}
```

---

Here are some descriptions of the json configuration items：

Feature Module	Description
readingbookmark	User-defined bookmark
outline	PDF document bookmark
annotations
(highlight, underline, squiggly, strikeout, insert, replace, line, rectangle, oval, arrow, pencil, eraser, typewriter, textbox, callout, note, stamp, polygon, cloud, polyline, measure, image, audio, video, redaction)	Annotation module collection
thumbnail	PDF page thumbnail display and page management
attachment	PDF document attachments and attachment annotations
signature	Digital signatures and handwritten signatures
fillSign	Fill flat forms (i.e. non-interactive forms) with text and symbols.
search	Text search
navigation	PDF page navigation
form	Form Filling and form data importing and exporting
selection	Text selection
encryption	PDF encryption
multipleSelection	Multiple annotations selection
runJavaScript	whether to allow to execute JavaScript
copyText	whether to allow to copy text
disableLink	whether to disable hyperlink

How to associate file to image object?

```objc
// Include Foxit SDK header files.
#import <FoxitRDK/FSPDFObjC.h>
```

```objc
//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static NSString *const sn = @"";
static NSString *const key = @"";

FSErrorCode error_code = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
{
 // Load a document
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:@"sample.pdf"];
 [doc load];

 FSAssociatedFiles *associated_files = [[FSAssociatedFiles alloc] initWithPdf_doc:doc];

 //Create filespec with 2.jpg
 FSFileSpec *filespec_jpg = [[FSFileSpec alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 [filespec_jpg setAssociteFileRelationship:FSAssociatedFilesRelationshipSource];
 [filespec_jpg setFileName:@"2.jpg"];
 filespec_jpg.description = @"jpeg";
 [filespec_jpg embed:@"2.jpg"];
 FSDateTime *dateTime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:2017 month:9 day:15 hour:17 minute:20 second:20 milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:8 utc_minute_offset:0];
 filespec_jpg.creationDateTime = dateTime;
 filespec_jpg.modifiedDateTime = dateTime;
 filespec_jpg.subtype = @"application/octet-stream";

 FSPDFPage *page = [doc getPage:0];
 [page startParse];
 long position = [page getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition:FSGraphicsObjectTypeImage];
 FSImageObject *image_oject = [[page getGraphicsObject:position] getImageObject];
 if (form_x_object) {
 [associated_files associateFileWithFormXobject:image_oject file_spec:filespec_jpg];
 }

 // Save PDF file
 [doc saveAs:@"newpdf.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
}
[FSLibrary destroy];
```

---

Add the scanning feature based on the full-featured PDF Reader

The scanning feature is a stand-alone module which is not shipped in the UI Extensions Component, so if you want to use this feature in your project, you should add the core code below to call the scan module:

```objc
#import <FoxitPDFScanUI/PDFScanManager.h>

// Initialize the scan module.
[PDFScanManager initializeScanner:0 serial2:0];
[PDFScanManager initializeCompression:0 serial2:0];

// Get the PDFScan controller.
UIViewController *VC = [[PDFScanManager shareManager] getPDFScanView];
if (VC) [self presentViewController:VC animated:YES completion:nil];

[PDFScanManager setSaveAsCallBack:^(NSError * _Nonnull error, NSString * _Nonnull savePath) {
 // <add your code>
}];
```

For PDFScanManager::initializeScanner and PDFScanManager::initializeCompression interfaces, if you set the parameters to 0, then the scanned image will be with watermark. If you do not want to have watermark, you should contact Foxit sales or support team to get the license key.

How to get associate files in graphics objects?

```objc
// Include Foxit SDK header files.
#import <FoxitRDK/FSPDFObjC.h>
```

```objc
//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static NSString *const sn = @"";
static NSString *const key = @"";

FSErrorCode error_code = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
{
 // Load a document
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:@"sample.pdf"];
 [doc load];

 FSAssociatedFiles *associated_files = [[FSAssociatedFiles alloc] initWithPdf_doc:doc];

 FSPDFPage *page = [doc getPage:0];
 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];

 long pos = [page getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition:FSGraphicsObjectTypeImage];
 FSGraphicsObject *image_x_object = [page getGraphicsObject:pos];
 int count = [associated_files getAssociatedFilesCountWithGraphicsObject:image_x_object];
 FSFileSpec *filespec = [associated_files getAssociatedFileWithGraphicsObject:image_x_object index:0];
 [filespec exportToFile:@"af_5.txt"];

 pos = [page getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition:FSGraphicsObjectTypeFormXObject];
 FSGraphicsObject *form_x_object = [page getGraphicsObject:pos];
 count = [associated_files getAssociatedFilesCountWithGraphicsObject:form_x_object];
 filespec = [associated_files getAssociatedFileWithGraphicsObject:form_x_object index:0];
 [filespec exportToFile:@"af_6.txt"];
}
[FSLibrary destroy];
```

How to associate file to catalog dictionary?

```objc
// Include Foxit SDK header files.

```

```objc
//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static NSString *const sn = @"";
static NSString *const key = @"";

FSErrorCode error_code = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
{
 // Load a document
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:@"sample.pdf"];
 [doc load];

 FSAssociatedFiles *associated_files = [[FSAssociatedFiles alloc] initWithPdf_doc:doc];

 // Create filespec with 1.txt
 FSFileSpec *filespec_txt = [[FSFileSpec alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 [filespec_txt setAssociteFileRelationship:FSAssociatedFilesRelationshipSource];
 [filespec_txt setFileName:@"1.txt"];
 FSDateTime *dateTime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:2017 month:9 day:15 hour:17 minute:20 second:20 milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:8 utc_minute_offset:0];
 filespec_txt.description = @"text";
 [filespec_txt embed:@"1.txt"];
 filespec_txt.creationDateTime = dateTime;
 filespec_txt.modifiedDateTime = dateTime;
 filespec_txt.subtype = @"application/octet-stream";

 [doc saveAs:@"newpdf.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
}
```

---

UI Extensions Component Overview

The UI Extensions Component uses "module" mechanism which refines each feature into a module.
All of the modules except LocalModule (used for file management) will be loaded by default if UI
Extensions is added. Users can customize module through implementing Module interface class,
and then call UIExtensionsManager#registerModule to register the custom module to current
UIExtensions manager. When not in use, you can call UIExtensionsManager#unregisterModule to
unregister it from current UIExtensions manager.
UIExtensionsManager contains the main-frame UI, such as top/bottom toolbar, and other UI
components which are shared between each module. Meanwhile, through UIExtensionsManager,
each feature module can also be loaded separately. And when loaded, the feature module will adapt
and adjust the main-frame UI, as well as establish the connection of message event response. Each
feature module may contain its module-specific UI components, and have its self-contained
message event handling logic. UIExtensionsManager will also be responsible for distributing
messages and events received from View Control component to each feature module.

Tool handler and annotation handler will process the events from touch screen or gestures of
PDFViewCtrl. When the touch screen and gestures occur, PDFViewCtrl will send the corresponding
events to UIExtensionsManager:
a) If a tool handler exists currently, UIExtensionsManager will send the corresponding events to
the current tool handler, and then event-handing process ends.
b) If an annotation is selected currently, UIExtensionsManager will send the corresponding
events to the annotation handler corresponding to the currently selected annotation, and
then event-handing process ends.
c) If currently no tool handler exists and no annotation is selected, UIExtensionsManager will
send the corresponding events to selection tool handler. Text Selection tool is used for
processing the related events for text selection. For example, select a piece of text, and add
Highlight annotation. Blank Selection tool is used for processing the related events for blank
space. For example, add a Note annotation on the blank space.
Note: Tool Handler and Annotation Handler will not respond the events at the same time. Tool Handler is
primarily used for annotation creation (currently, the creation of link annotation is not supported),
signature creation and text selection. Annotation Handler is mainly used for annotation editing and form
filling. The following figure shows the event response flow chart between Tool Handler and Annotation
Handler.

---

How to get bookmark information?

```objc
// Include Foxit SDK header files.
#import <FoxitRDK/FSPDFObjC.h>
```

```objc
//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static NSString *const sn = @"";
static NSString *const key = @"";

void showBookmarkInfo(FSBookmark *bookmark, NSMutableString *doc, int depth) {
 if (depth > 32)
 return;
 if ([bookmark isEmpty])
 return;
 for (int i = 0; i < depth; i++) {
 [doc appendString:@"\t"];
 }

 // Show bookmark's title.
 [doc appendFormat:@"%@\t", [bookmark getTitle]];

 // Show bookmark's color.
 [doc appendFormat:@"color: %x\r\n", [bookmark getColor]];

 showBookmarkInfo([bookmark getFirstChild], doc, depth + 1);
 showBookmarkInfo([bookmark getNextSibling], doc, depth);
}

void showBookmarksInfo(FSPDFDoc *doc, NSString *info_path) {
 NSMutableString *text_doc = [NSMutableString string];
 FSBookmark *root = [doc getRootBookmark];
 if (![root isEmpty]) {
 showBookmarkInfo(root, text_doc, 0);
 } else {
 [text_doc appendString:@"No bookmark information!\r\n"];
 }
 [text_doc writeToFile:info_path atomically:YES encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding error:nil];
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 int err_ret = 0;
 FSErrorCode error_code = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:@"AboutFoxit.pdf"];
 [doc load];

 // Show original bookmark information.
 showBookmarksInfo(doc, @"bookmark_info.txt");
 }

 [FSLibrary destroy];
 return err_ret;
}
```

How to add a link annotation

```objc
// Include Foxit SDK header files.
#import <FoxitRDK/FSPDFObjC.h>
```

```objc
//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static NSString *const sn = @"";
static NSString *const key = @"";

FSErrorCode error_code = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
{
 // Load a document
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:@"sample.pdf"];
 [doc load];

 FSPDFPage *page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add link annotation
 FSRectF *rectF = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:350 bottom1:350 right1:380 top1:400];
 FSAnnot *annot = [page addAnnot:FSAnnotUnderline rect:rectF];
 FSLink *link = [[FSLink alloc] initWithAnnot:annot];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 link.flags = FSAnnotFlagPrint;
 link.highlightingMode = FSAnnotHighlightingPush;

 // Add action for link annotation

 FSURIAction *action = [[FSURIAction alloc] initWithAction:[FSAction create:doc action_type:FSActionTypeURI]];
 [action setTrackPositionFlag:YES];
 action.uRI = @"www.foxitsoftware.com";
 link.action = action;
 [link resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a link annotation.");

 // Save PDF file
 [doc saveAs:@"newpdf.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
}
[FSLibrary destroy];
```

---

The three elements of Foxit PDF SDK for Android, iOS and UWP

1. PDF Core API
The PDF Core API is the heart of this SDK and is built on Foxit’s powerful underlying technology. It
provides the functionality for basic PDF operation features, and is utilized by the PDF View Control
and UI Extensions Component, which ensures the apps can achieve high performance and
efficiency. The Core API can be used independently for document rendering, analysis, text
extraction, text search, form filling, digital signatures, Pressure Sensitive Ink, certificate and
password security, annotation creation and manipulation and much more.
2. PDF View Control
The PDF View Control is a utility class that provides the functionality for developers to interact with
rendering PDF documents per their requirements. With Foxit’s renowned and widely used PDF
rendering technology at its core, the View Control provides fast and high quality rendering, zooming,
scrolling and page navigation features. The View Control derives from platform related viewer
classes such as UIView on iOS and allows for extension to accommodate specific user needs.
• UI Extensions Component
The UI Extensions Component is an open source library that provides a customizable user interface
with built-in support for text selection, markup annotation, outline navigation, reading bookmarks,
full-text searching, form filling, text reflow, attachment, digital/handwritten signature, reflow,
document editing and password encryption. These features in the UI Extensions Component are
3。Foxit PDF SDK for iOS
Developer Guide
implemented using the PDF Core API and PDF View Control. Developers can utilize these ready-touse UI implementations to build a PDF viewer quickly with the added benefit of complete flexibility
and control to customize the UI design as desired.
From version 4.0, Foxit PDF SDK for iOS made a big change and optimization for the UI Extensions
Component. Now, it wraps the basic UI implementations to FSPDFReader class, such as panel
controller, toolbar settings, and alert view, etc. Building a full-featured PDF Reader is getting simpler
and easier. Furthermore, users can flexibly customize the features they want through a
configuration file.
From version 5.0, Foxit PDF SDK for iOS removed the FSPDFReader class, and moved the wrapped
APIs in FSPDFReader class to UI Extensions Component. In version 5.0, every element in the built-in
UI can be configurable. More advanced APIs and more powerful configuration file are provided for
developers to further customize the UI elements, such as showing or hiding a specific panel,
top/bottom toolbar, the items in the top toolbar, and the items in the View setting bar and More
Menu view.

```objc
 // Load a document

 // Create filespec with 1.txt

 [filespec_txt setFileName:@"1.txt"];
```

What is in the Package
Foxit PDF SDK for iOS provides two packages as follows:

> * foxitpdfsdk_xx_ios.zip: only support building apps on an iPhone or iPad.
> * foxitpdfsdk_xx_ios_catalyst.zip: support building apps on an iPhone, iPad or a Mac.

Note: If you want to build apps on macOS, you can choose the foxitpdfsdk_xx_ios_catalyst.zip package.

How to add a freetext annotation as textbox

```objc
// Include Foxit SDK header files.
#import <FoxitRDK/FSPDFObjC.h>
```

```objc
//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static NSString *const sn = @"";
static NSString *const key = @"";

FSErrorCode error_code = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
{
 // Load a document
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:@"sample.pdf"];
 [doc load];

 FSPDFPage *page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add freetext annotation, as text box.
 FSRectF *rectF = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:450 bottom1:550 right1:550 top1:600];
 FSAnnot *annot = [page addAnnot:FSAnnotFreeText rect:rectF];
 FSFreeText *freetext = [[FSFreeText alloc] initWithAnnot:annot];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 freetext.flags = FSAnnotFlagPrint;
 // Set default appearance
 FSDefaultAppearance *default_ap = [FSDefaultAppearance new];
 default_ap.flags = FSDefaultAppearanceFlagFont | FSDefaultAppearanceFlagFontSize | FSDefaultAppearanceFlagTextColor;
 default_ap.font = [[FSFont alloc] initWithFont_id:FSFontStdIDHelveticaB];
 default_ap.text_size = 12.0f;
 default_ap.text_color = 0x000000;
 freetext.defaultAppearance = default_ap;
 // Set default appearance for form.
 freetext.content = @"A text box annotation.";
 freetext.subject = @"Textbox";
 freetext.title = @"Foxit SDK";
 freetext.creationDateTime = [FSDateTime getLocalTime];
 freetext.modifiedDateTime = [FSDateTime getLocalTime];

 // Appearance must be reset.
 [freetext resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a text box freetext annotation.");

 // Save PDF file
 [doc saveAs:@"newpdf.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
}
[FSLibrary destroy];
```

---

Foxit PDF SDK for iOS

Foxit PDF SDK allows users to download trial version to evaluate SDK. The trial version has no difference from the standard licensed version except for the free 10-day trial limitation and the trial watermarks in the generated pages. After the evaluation period expires, customers should contact the Foxit sales team and purchase licenses to continue using Foxit PDF SDK.

Developers should purchase licenses to use Foxit PDF SDK in their solutions. Licenses grant developers permission to release their apps which utilize Foxit PDF SDK. However, users are prohibited to distribute any documents, sample code, or source code in the released package of Foxit PDF SDK to any third party without written permission from Foxit Software Incorporated.

How to add a line annotation

```objc
// Include Foxit SDK header files.
#import <FoxitRDK/FSPDFObjC.h>
```

```objc
//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static NSString *const sn = @"";
static NSString *const key = @"";

FSErrorCode error_code = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
{
 // Load a document
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:@"sample.pdf"];
 [doc load];

 FSPDFPage *page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add line annotation
 // No special intent, as a common line.
 FSRectF *rectF = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:0 bottom1:650 right1:100 top1:750];
 FSAnnot *annot = [page addAnnot:FSAnnotLine rect:rectF];
 FSLine *line = [[FSLine alloc] initWithAnnot:annot];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 line.flags = FSAnnotFlagPrint;
 line.startPoint = [[FSPointF alloc] initWithX:20 Y:650];
 line.endPoint = [[FSPointF alloc] initWithX:100 Y:740];
 // Intent, as line arrow.
 line.content = @"A line arrow annotation";
 line.intent = @"LineArrow";
 line.subject = @"Arrow";
 line.title = @"Foxit SDK";
 line.creationDateTime = [FSDateTime getLocalTime];
 line.modifiedDateTime = [FSDateTime getLocalTime];
 // Appearance must be reset.
 [line resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a line annotation.");

 // Save PDF file
 [doc saveAs:@"newpdf.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
}
[FSLibrary destroy];
```

How to compare two pdf documents and marked the difference of replace text type.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"
NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";
FSDateTime* getLocalDateTime() {
 time_t t = time(NULL);
 struct tm* rime = localtime(&t);
 tzset();
 int timezone_hour = (int)timezone / 3600 * -1;
 int timezone_minute = (abs((int)timezone) % 3600) / 60;
 FSDateTime* datetime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:(rime->tm_year + 1900) month:(rime->tm_mon + 1) day:(rime->tm_mday) hour:(rime->tm_hour) minute:(rime->tm_min) second:(rime->tm_sec) milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:timezone_hour utc_minute_offset:timezone_minute];

 return datetime;
}

NSString* randomUID() {
 NSString* uuid = @"";
 const char* c = "0123456789qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm";
 for (int n = 0; n < 16; n++) {
 NSString* uuid_temp = @"";
 int b = rand() % 255;
 switch (n) {
 case 6:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"4%x", b % 15];
 break;
 case 8:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%c%x", c[rand() % strlen(c)], b % 15];
 break;
 default:
 uuid_temp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%02x", b];
 break;
 }
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:uuid_temp];
 switch (n) {
 case 3:
 case 5:
 case 7:
 case 9:
 uuid = [uuid stringByAppendingString:@"-"];
 break;
 }
 }
 return uuid;
}
void createSquigglyRect(FSPDFPage* page, FSRectFArray* rects, int color, NSString *csContents, NSString *csType, NSString *csObjType) {
 if (rects == NULL) return;
 int rectSize = [rects getSize];
 if (rectSize == 0) return;
 FSRectF* annot_rect = [[FSRectF alloc] init];
 FSSquiggly* squiggly = [[FSSquiggly alloc] initWithAnnot:[page addAnnot:FSAnnotSquiggly rect:annot_rect]];
 [squiggly setContent:csContents];

 FSQuadPointsArray* quad_points_array = [FSQuadPointsArray new];

 for (int i=0; i<rectSize; i++)
 {
 FSRectF* item = [rects getAt:i];
 FSQuadPoints* quad_points = [FSQuadPoints new];
 FSPointF* point = [FSPointF new];
 [point set:item.left y:item.top];
 quad_points.first = point;
 [point set:item.right y:item.top];
 quad_points.second = point;
 [point set:item.left y:item.bottom];
 quad_points.third = point;
 [point set:item.right y:item.bottom];
 quad_points.fourth = point;
 [quad_points_array add:quad_points];
 }
 [squiggly setQuadPoints:quad_points_array];
 [squiggly setBorderColor:color];
 [squiggly setSubject:csObjType];
 [squiggly setTitle:csType];
 FSDateTime* local_time = getLocalDateTime();
 [squiggly setCreationDateTime:local_time];
 [squiggly setModifiedDateTime:local_time];
 [squiggly setUniqueID:randomUID()];

 [squiggly resetAppearanceStream];
}
int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *base_doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_base_file];
 errorCode = [base_doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }
 FSPDFDoc *compared_doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_compared_file];
 errorCode = [compared_doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 FSComparison* comparison = [[FSComparison alloc] initWithBase_doc:base_doc compared_doc:compared_doc];
 FSCompareResults* result = [comparison doCompare:0 compared_page_index:0 compare_flags:FSComparisonCompareTypeText];
 int oldInfoSize = [result.base_doc_results getSize];
 FSPDFPage* page1 = [base_doc getPage:0];
 for (int i=0; i<oldInfoSize; i++)
 {
 FSCompareResultInfo* item = [result.compared_doc_results getAt:i];
 FSCompareResultInfoCompareResultType type = item.type;
 if (type == FSCompareResultInfoCompareResultTypeReplaceText)
 {
 NSString* res_string = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"[Old]: \"%@\"\r\n[New]: \"%@\"",[result.base_doc_results getAt:i].diff_contents,item.diff_contents];
 createSquigglyRect(page1, item.rect_array, 0xe7651a, res_string, @"Compare : Replace", @"Text");
 }
 }
 FSPDFDoc* new_doc = [comparison generateComparedDoc:FSComparisonCompareTypeAll];
 [new_doc saveAs:@"generate_result.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNormal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

## 如何修改默认文件夹？

截止RDK v8.4，RDK不支持自定义文件夹的选择，即没有提供接口。（v8.4之后的版本情况不详）

但RDK包中有提供UI Extensions Component的源码，可以通过直接调整源码来达到目的。

使用源码的方式，请参看\docs目录下的`developer_guide_ios.pdf`，"5 Customizing User Interface"。

源码位置：`\libs\uiextensions_src`

How to get all annotations in all pages?

```objc
// Include Foxit SDK header files.
#import <FoxitRDK/FSPDFObjC.h>
```

```objc
//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static NSString *const sn = @"";
static NSString *const key = @"";

FSErrorCode error_code = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
{
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:@"Sample"];
 FSErrorCode error_code = [doc load:@"123"];
 if (error_code != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Load document error!");
 }
 int page_count = [doc getPageCount];
 for (int i = 0; i < page_count; i++) {
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc getPage:i];
 int annot_count = [page getAnnotCount];
 for (int j = 0; j < annot_count; j++) {
 FSAnnot *annot = [page getAnnot:j];
 }
 }
}
[FSLibrary destroy];
```

How can I set whether to highlight the links in PDF documents? And how to set the highlight color if I want to highlight links?

By default, highlighting links in PDF documents is enabled. If you want to disable it or to set the highlight color, you can do it in the configuration JSON file (only support for version 6.3 or higher) or by calling the APIs.
Note: If you want to set the highlight color, please make sure the highlighting links feature is enabled.

1.Through JSON file
Set ""highlightLink": false," to disable highlighting the links in PDF document.
Set ""highlightLinkColor": "#16007000"," to set the highlight color (input the color value as you wish).

2.Through calling API
UIExtensionsManager.enableHighlightLinks property is provided to set whether to enable highlighting the links in PDF documents. If you do not want to highlight links, please set the parameter to "false" as follows:

```objc
// Assume you have already Initialized a UIExtensionsManager object
extensionsManager.enableHighlightLinks = false;
```
UIExtensionsManager.linksHighlightColor property is used to set the highlight color. Following is a sample for setting this property:

```objc
// Assume you have already Initialized a UIExtensionsManager object
extensionsManager.linksHighlightColor = [UIColor colorWithRed:0 green:0 blue:1 alpha:0.3];
```

---

How can I automatically update page binding to support Right-to-Left?

For most languages, the reading habits we use are left-to-right, which calls for a page binding on the left edge. However, there are also some languages that read from right to left, such as Arabic and Hebrew and several East Asian scripts. In this case, binding on the right edge is preferable for users, which the pages will be arranged from right to left (the first page is on the top right). To do this, we made the adaptation of the right-to-left page layout.
The page binding is used with horizontal scrolling. For vertical scrolling, it has effect only when double-page mode is enabled.
Updating the Page Binding Programmatically
Foxit PDF SDK for iOS defines an enumeration in the FSPDFViewCtrl class to infer how a document should be presented to the user. The possible values are:
> * PDF_PAGE_BINDING_LEFT_EDGE: the document flows from left to right
> * PDF_PAGE_BINDING_RIGHT_EDGE: the document flows from right to left
> * PDF_PAGE_BINDING_UNKNOWN: the document doesn’t explicitly define a page binding, so the behavior may be the same as it is with
```objc
PDF_PAGE_BINDING_LEFT_EDGE
 /**
 * @brief Enumeration for page binding edge.
 *
 * @details Values of this enumeration should be used alone.
 */
typedef enum {
 /** The document doesn’t explicitly define a page binding, so the behavior is the same as it is with LEFT_EDGE or RIGHT_EDGE.*/
 PDF_PAGE_BINDING_UNKNOWN = 0,
 /** The document flows from left to right.*/
 PDF_PAGE_BINDING_LEFT_EDGE = 1,
 /** The document flows from right to left.*/
 PDF_PAGE_BINDING_RIGHT_EDGE = 2,
} PDF_PAGE_BINDING_EDGE;
```
Then, call the following function to update the page binding to swith the page layout:
```objc
[pdfViewerCtrl setPageBindingEdge:PDF_PAGE_BINDING_RIGHT_EDGE];
```

Updating the Page Binding via the UI
You can create a demo using uiextensionsDynamic.framework or use complete_pdf_viewer demo directly to update the page binding. After running the demo, find the View settings bar, you can enable or disable the Right to Letf.

How to add a freetext annotation as typewriter

```objc
// Include Foxit SDK header files.
#import <FoxitRDK/FSPDFObjC.h>
```

```objc
//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static NSString *const sn = @"";
static NSString *const key = @"";

FSErrorCode error_code = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
{
 // Load a document
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:@"sample.pdf"];
 [doc load];

 FSPDFPage *page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add freetext annotation, as type writer.
 FSRectF *rectF = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:10 bottom1:550 right1:200 top1:600];
 FSAnnot *annot = [page addAnnot:FSAnnotFreeText rect:rectF];
 FSFreeText *freetext = [[FSFreeText alloc] initWithAnnot:annot];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 freetext.flags = FSAnnotFlagPrint;
 // Set default appearance
 FSDefaultAppearance *default_ap = [FSDefaultAppearance new];
 default_ap.flags = FSDefaultAppearanceFlagFont | FSDefaultAppearanceFlagFontSize | FSDefaultAppearanceFlagTextColor;
 default_ap.font = [[FSFont alloc] initWithFont_id:FSFontStdIDHelvetica];
 default_ap.text_size = 12.0f;
 default_ap.text_color = 0x000000;
 freetext.defaultAppearance = default_ap;
 freetext.intent = @"FreeTextTypewriter";
 freetext.content = @"A typewriter annotation";
 freetext.subject = @"FreeTextTypewriter";
 freetext.title = @"Foxit SDK";
 freetext.creationDateTime = [FSDateTime getLocalTime];
 freetext.modifiedDateTime = [FSDateTime getLocalTime];

 // Appearance must be reset.
 [freetext resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a typewriter freetext annotation.");

 // Save PDF file
 [doc saveAs:@"newpdf.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
}
[FSLibrary destroy];
```

How to add a "file attachment" annotation

```objc
// Include Foxit SDK header files.
#import <FoxitRDK/FSPDFObjC.h>
```

```objc
//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static NSString *const sn = @"";
static NSString *const key = @"";

FSErrorCode error_code = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
{
 // Load a document
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:@"sample.pdf"];
 [doc load];

 FSPDFPage *page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add file attachment annotation
 NSString *pdf_file = @"AboutFoxit.pdf";
 FSRectF *rectF = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:280 bottom1:350 right1:300 top1:380];
 FSAnnot *annot = [page addAnnot:FSAnnotFileAttachment rect:rectF];
 FSFileAttachment *file_attachment = [[FSFileAttachment alloc] initWithAnnot:annot];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 file_attachment.flags = FSAnnotFlagPrint;
 file_attachment.iconName = @"Graph";

 FSFileSpec *file_spec = [[FSFileSpec alloc] initWithDocument:[page getDocument]];
 file_spec.fileName = @"attachment.pdf";
 file_spec.description = @"The original file";
 [file_spec embed:pdf_file];
 file_attachment.fileSpec = file_spec;
 file_attachment.subject = @"File Attachment";
 file_attachment.title = @"Foxit SDK";
 file_attachment.creationDateTime = [FSDateTime getLocalTime];
 file_attachment.modifiedDateTime = [FSDateTime getLocalTime];

 // Appearance must be reset.
 [file_attachment resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a attachment annotation.");

 // Save PDF file
 [doc saveAs:@"newpdf.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
}
[FSLibrary destroy];
```

How to transform bitmap?

```objc
// Include Foxit SDK header files.
#import <FoxitRDK/FSPDFObjC.h>
```

```objc
//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static NSString *const sn = @"";
static NSString *const key = @"";

void saveBitmap(FSBitmap * bitmap, NSString *bmp_name)
{
 // Add the bitmap to image and save the image.
 FSImage *image = [FSImage new];
 [image addFrame:bitmap];

 [image saveAs:bmp_name];;
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 int err_ret = 0;
 FSErrorCode error_code = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 {
 FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] initWithPath:@"Sample.png"];
 FSBitmap *bitmap = [image getFrameBitmap:0];

 int width = [bitmap getWidth];
 int height = [bitmap getHeight];

 // Transform bitmap.
 int left, top;
 FSMatrix2D *matrix2D = [[FSMatrix2D alloc] initWithA1:width * 2.0f b1:0.f c1:0.f d1:height / 2.0f e1:0.f f1:0.f];
 FSBitmap *transform_bitmap = [bitmap transformTo:matrix2D flag:FSBitmapDownsample out_left:&left out_top:&top];
 saveBitmap(transform_bitmap, @"transform_bitmap_Foxit.bmp");
 }

 [FSLibrary destroy];
 return err_ret;
}
```

---

The package without Mac Catalyst

In the "libs" folder, there are items that make up the core components of Foxit PDF SDK for iOS, and a configuration file for cocoaPods tool and a script file for stripping the arm architectures.

> * FoxitRDK.framework – The framework that includes the Foxit PDF SDK dynamic library and associated header files.
> * uiextensionsDynamic.framework – The framework that includes UIExtensions dynamic library, associated header files, and the resource files that are needed for the default built-in UI implementations.
> * FoxitPDFScanUI.framework – The framework that includes Foxit PDF SDK for scanning dynamic library, associated header files, and the resource files that are needed for the default built-in UI implementations of scanning feature.
> * FoxitPDF.podspec – A configuration file for cocoaPods tool which is used to manage the third-party libraries. It has been used in section "Implement Foxit PDF SDK for iOS using React Native".
> * prepare-framework-to-publish-to-appstore.sh – A script file used to strip the arm architectures from Foxit SDK Framwork. This is because Foxit SDK Framwork includes arm64, armv7, i386, and x86_64 architectures, but the i386, and x86_64 architectures are not allowed to be uploaded to Apple App Store.
> * pdfscan project – It is an open source library that contains the UI implementations for scanning feature, which can help developers rapidly integrate scanning feature into their iOS app, or customize the UI for scanning as desired.
> * uiextensions project – found in the "libs/uiextensions_src" folder. It is an open source library that contains some ready-to-use UI module implementations and the basic UI design for app, which can help developers rapidly embed a fully functional PDF reader into their iOS app. Of course, developers are not forced to use the default UI, they can freely customize and design the UI for their specific apps through the "uiextensions" project.
Note: For iOS 13 or higher, you should use Xcode 11 or higher to build the "uiextensions" project.

---

Customize UI implementation through source code

If you do not want to use the ready-made UI framework, you can redesign it through modifying the source code of the UI Extensions Component.
There is one thing to take note of. The source code of the UI Extensions Component is written in Objective-C, so you need to use Objective-C to modify the UI layout. If you are a Swift developer and not already familiar with Objective-C, you might only be able to customize the UI appearance that does not need writing code, such as icons and other UI resources.
To customize the UI implementation, you need to follow these steps:
First, add the following required files into your app.
> * FoxitRDK.framework – The framework that includes the Foxit PDF SDK for iOS dynamic library and associated header files. It can be found in the "libs" folder.
> * uiextensions project – It is an open source library that contains some ready-to-use UI module implementations, which can help developers rapidly embed a fully functional PDF reader into their iOS app. Of course, developers are not forced to use the default UI, they can freely customize and design the UI for their specific apps through the "uiextensions" project. It can be found in the "libs/uiextensions_src" folder.
Tip: The built-in UI customization can be done in the uiextensions project, and then you can add the new uiextensionsDynamic.framework generated by the modified uiextensions project to your app instead of the whole uiextensions project.
Second, find the specific code or images related to the UI that you want to customize in the uiextensions project, then modify them based on your requirements.

How to add a squiggly annotation

```objc
// Include Foxit SDK header files.
#import <FoxitRDK/FSPDFObjC.h>
```

```objc
//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static NSString *const sn = @"";
static NSString *const key = @"";

FSErrorCode error_code = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
{
 // Load a document
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:@"sample.pdf"];
 [doc load];

 FSPDFPage *page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add squiggly annotation.
 FSRectF *rectF = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:200 bottom1:450 right1:300 top1:550];
 FSAnnot *annot = [page addAnnot:FSAnnotSquiggly rect:rectF];
 FSSquiggly *squiggly = [[FSSquiggly alloc] initWithAnnot:annot];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 squiggly.flags = FSAnnotFlagPrint;
 squiggly.intent = @"Squiggly";

 FSQuadPoints *quad_points = [FSQuadPoints new];
 quad_points.first = [[FSPointF alloc] initWithX:210 Y:500];
 quad_points.second = [[FSPointF alloc] initWithX:290 Y:500];
 quad_points.third = [[FSPointF alloc] initWithX:210 Y:480];
 quad_points.fourth = [[FSPointF alloc] initWithX:290 Y:480];
 FSQuadPointsArray *quad_points_array = [FSQuadPointsArray new];
 [quad_points_array add:quad_points];
 squiggly.quadPoints = quad_points_array;
 squiggly.subject = @"Squiggly";
 squiggly.title = @"Foxit SDK";
 squiggly.creationDateTime = [FSDateTime getLocalTime];
 squiggly.modifiedDateTime = [FSDateTime getLocalTime];

 // Appearance must be reset.
 [underline resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a squiggly annotation.");

 // Save PDF file
 [doc saveAs:@"newpdf.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
}
[FSLibrary destroy];
```

How to adds a new PDF page to document, from a named template.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString* sn = @"";
NSString* key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {

 @autoreleasepool {
 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"Library Initialize Error: %ld", errorCode);
 return -1;
 }

 @try {
 NSString* input_pdf_path = @"/Users/xxx/Desktop/test.pdf";
 // Load a document
 FSPDFDoc* doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_pdf_path];
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [doc load:nil];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 NSLog(@"The Doc [%@] Error: %ld", input_pdf_path, errorCode);
 return -1;
 }
 FSPDFNameTree* templates_name_tree = [[FSPDFNameTree alloc] initWithDocument:doc type:FSPDFNameTreeTemplates];
 if ([templates_name_tree hasName:@"Page3"]) {
 [doc addPageFromTemplate: @"Page3"];
 }
 // Save PDF file
 NSString* save_pdf_path = @"/Users/xxx/Desktop/add_test_template.pdf";
 [doc saveAs:save_pdf_path save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 }
}

How to swap bitmap?

```objc
// Include Foxit SDK header files.
#import <FoxitRDK/FSPDFObjC.h>
```

```objc
//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static NSString *const sn = @"";
static NSString *const key = @"";

void saveBitmap(FSBitmap * bitmap, NSString *bmp_name)
{
 // Add the bitmap to image and save the image.
 FSImage *image = [FSImage new];
 [image addFrame:bitmap];

 [image saveAs:bmp_name];;
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 int err_ret = 0;
 FSErrorCode error_code = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 {
 FSImage *image = [[FSImage alloc] initWithPath:@"Sample.png"];
 FSBitmap *bitmap = [image getFrameBitmap:0];

 // Swap the X and Y axis, and then vertical and horizontal flip bitmap.
 FSBitmap *swap_xy_bitmap = [bitmap swapXY:true is_flip_vert:true];
 saveBitmap(swap_xy_bitmap, @"swap_xy_flip_horz_vert_Foxit.bmp");
 }

 [FSLibrary destroy];
 return err_ret;
}
```

Customize to hide the UI elements in the More Menu view

You only need to use the following API:

```objc
//Set the enabled state of group according to "groupTag".
- [MoreMenuView setMoreViewItemHiddenWithGroup:(NSUInteger)groupTag hidden:(BOOL)isHidden];

//Set the enabled state of item according to "groupTag" and "itemTag".
- [MoreMenuView setMoreViewItemHiddenWithGroup:(NSUInteger)groupTag andItemTag:(NSUInteger)itemTag hidden:(BOOL)isHidden];

//Set visible or invisible state for the individual group.
- [MoreMenuView setIndividualMenuItemHiddenWithItemTag:(NSUInteger)itemTag hidden:	(BOOL)isHidden
```

The values of the parameters "groupTag" and "itemTag" in the setMoreViewItemHiddenWithGroup interface can be set as follows:

1.groupTag NSUInteger
TAG_GROUP_PROTECT	10
TAG_GROUP_COMMENT_FIELD	20
TAG_GROUP_PROTECT	TAG_ITEM_REDACTION	10
TAG_ITEM_PASSWORD	20
TAG_ITEM_CERTIFICATE	30
TAG_GROUP_COMMENT_FIELD	TAG_ITEM_IMPORTCOMMENT	40
TAG_ITEM_EXPORTCOMMENT	50
TAG_ITEM_SUMARIZECOMMENT	60
TAG_ITEM_RESETFORM	70
TAG_ITEM_IMPORTFORM	80
TAG_ITEM_EXPORTFORM	90

2.The value of the parameter "itemTag" in the setIndividualMenuItemHiddenWithItemTag interface can be set as follows:
itemTag	NSUInteger
TAG_ITEM_SAVE_AS	110
TAG_ITEM_REDUCEFILESIZE	120
TAG_ITEM_WIRELESSPRINT	130
TAG_ITEM_FLATTEN	140
TAG_ITEM_SCREENCAPTURE	150

How to get associate files in Marked Content

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 NSString *input_file = @"AF_Catalog_Page_Annot.pdf"

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 input_file = @"AF_MarkedContent.pdf";
 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 FSAssociatedFiles *associated_files = [[FSAssociatedFiles alloc] initWithPdf_doc:doc];

 FSPDFPage *page = [doc getPage:0];
 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];

 long pos = [page getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition:FSGraphicsObjectTypeText];
 FSGraphicsObject *text_object = [page getGraphicsObject:pos];
 int count = [associated_files getAssociatedFilesCountWithGraphicsObject:text_object];
 FSFileSpec *filespec = [associated_files getAssociatedFileWithGraphicsObject:text_object index:0];
 [filespec exportToFile:@"bitmap.bmp"];

 filespec = [associated_files getAssociatedFileWithGraphicsObject:text_object index:1];
 [filespec exportToFile:@"text.txt"];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

如何修改主题色

使用`-[UIExtensionsManager primaryColor]`接口来设置你的主题色，

示例代码：
```objc
// 导入
#import <FoxitRDK/FSPDFViewControl.h>
#import <uiextensionsDynamic/UIExtensionsManager.h>

- (void)viewDidLoad {
 [super viewDidLoad];
 FSPDFViewCtrl *pdfViewControl = [[FSPDFViewCtrl alloc] initWithFrame:[UIScreen mainScreen].bounds];
 UIExtensionsManager *extensionsMgr = [[UIExtensionsManager alloc] initWithPDFViewControl:pdfViewControl];
 extensionsMgr.primaryColor = [UIColor yellowColor];
}
```

另外可以在`FSFoundation/FSPreferences.h`配置一些其它的颜色(源码位置`uiextensions_src/FSFoundation/Utilities/FSPreferences.h`)

注意：

 FSPreferences并未导出到API reference，也就是没有注释说明

 该方法执行后，主题色才会发生变化。建议在app初始化或初始创建时就调用。

Add an item in the right top toolbar at the first position. (For Phone and Tablet)

```objc
FSMainTopbar *topbar = self.extensionsMgr.topToolbar;
NSMutableArray *items = topbar.itemsForPositionRight.mutableCopy;
UIButton *btn = [UIButton new];
[btn setImage:[UIImage imageNamed:@"your image"] forState:UIControlStateNormal];
FSMainToolbarItem *item = [[FSMainToolbarItem alloc] initWithCustomView:btn];
[items insertObject:item atIndex:0];
topbar.itemsForPositionRight = items;
```

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add associate files into image form xObject.

#include "FSPDFObjC.h"

NSString *sn = @"";
NSString *key = @"";

int main(int argc, const char *argv[]) {
 @autoreleasepool {
 NSString *input_file = @"AF_Catalog_Page_Annot.pdf"

 // Initialize library
 FSErrorCode errorCode = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 // Associate files with objects in PDF documents.
 input_file = @"AssociateTestFile.pdf";
 @try {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:input_file];
 errorCode = [doc load:@""];
 if (errorCode != FSErrSuccess) {
 return -1;
 }

 FSAssociatedFiles *associated_files = [[FSAssociatedFiles alloc] initWithPdf_doc:doc];

 // Create filespec with 2.jpg image.
 FSFileSpec *filespec_jpg = [[FSFileSpec alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 filespec_jpg.associteFileRelationship = FSAssociatedFilesRelationshipSource;
 filespec_jpg.fileName = @"2.jpg";
 filespec_jpg.description = @"jpeg";
 [filespec_jpg embed:@"2.jpg"];
 filespec_jpg.creationDateTime = dateTime;
 filespec_jpg.modifiedDateTime = dateTime;

 // Associate 2.jpg with form XObject.
 {
 long position = [page getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition:FSGraphicsObjectTypeFormXObject];
 FSFormXObject *form_x_object = [[page getGraphicsObject:position] getFormXObject];
 if (form_x_object != nil) {
 [associated_files associateFileWithFormXObject:form_x_object file_spec:filespec_jpg];

 FSPDFStream *stream = [form_x_object getStream];
 FSPDFDictionary *dictionary = [stream getDictionary];
 FSFileSpec *filespec_form_x_object = [associated_files getAssociatedFile:dictionary index:0];
 [filespec_form_x_object exportToFile:"form_x_object.jpg"];
 }
 }

 // Save PDF file
 [doc saveAs:@"associated_files.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }
 @catch (NSException *e) {
 NSLog(@"Unknown Exception, %@", e);
 }
 return 0;
 }
}

---

How to add a square annotation

```objc
// Include Foxit SDK header files.
#import <FoxitRDK/FSPDFObjC.h>
```

```objc
//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static NSString *const sn = @"";
static NSString *const key = @"";

FSErrorCode error_code = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
{
 // Load a document
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:@"sample.pdf"];
 [doc load];

 FSPDFPage *page = [doc getPage:0];

 // Add square annotation
 FSRectF *rectF = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:200 bottom1:650 right1:300 top1:750];
 FSAnnot *annot = [page addAnnot:FSAnnotSquare rect:rectF];
 FSSquare *square = [[FSSquare alloc] initWithAnnot:annot];
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 square.flags = FSAnnotFlagPrint;
 square.fillColor = 0x00FF00;
 square.innerRect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:220 bottom1:660 right1:260 top1:740];
 square.subject = @"Square";
 square.title = @"Foxit SDK";
 square.creationDateTime = [FSDateTime getLocalTime];
 square.modifiedDateTime = [FSDateTime getLocalTime];

 // Appearance must be reset.
 [square resetAppearanceStream];
 NSLog(@"Add a square annotation.");

 // Save PDF file
 [doc saveAs:@"newpdf.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
}
[FSLibrary destroy];
```

Add an item to the bottom toolbar at the first position. (Only for Phone)

```objc
FSMainBottombar *bottomBar = self.extensionsMgr.bottomToolbar;
NSMutableArray *items = bottomBar.itemsForPositionCenter.mutableCopy;
UIButton *btn = [UIButton new];
[btn setImage:[UIImage imageNamed:@"your image"] forState:UIControlStateNormal];
FSMainToolbarItem *item = [[FSMainToolbarItem alloc] initWithCustomView:btn];
[items insertObject:item atIndex:0];
bottomBar.itemsForPositionCenter = items;
```

How to create a root node for bookmark?

```objc
// Include Foxit SDK header files.
#import <FoxitRDK/FSPDFObjC.h>
```

```objc
//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static NSString *const sn = @"";
static NSString *const key = @"";

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
 int err_ret = 0;
 FSErrorCode error_code = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
 {
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:@"AboutFoxit.pdf"];
 [doc load];

 //Get bookmark root node or Create new bookmark root node.
 FSBookmark *root = [doc getRootBookmark];
 if ([root isEmpty])
 root = [doc createRootBookmark];
 for (int i = 0; i < [doc getPageCount]; i += 2) {
 FSDestination *dest = [FSDestination createFitPage:doc page_index:i];
 FSBookmark *child = [root insert:[NSString stringWithFormat:@"A bookmark to a page (index: %d)", i] position:FSBookmarkPosLastChild];
 child.destination = dest;
 child.color = i * 0xF68C21;
 }

 // Save PDF file
 [doc saveAs:@"newpdf.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
 }

 [FSLibrary destroy];
 return err_ret;
}
```

```objc
[self.extensionsMgr.more setMoreViewItemHiddenWithGroup:TAG_GROUP_PROTECT andItemTag:TAG_ITEM_REDACTION hidden:YES];
```
Swift:

```swift
extensionsManager.more.setMoreViewItemHiddenWithGroup(UInt(TAG_GROUP_PROTECT), andItemTag:UInt(TAG_ITEM_REDACTION), hidden: true);
```

Customize to hide the UI elements in the View setting bar

You only need to use the following API:

// SettingItemType enum
```objc
/**
 * @brief	Enumeration for item types in setting bar.
 *
 * @details	Values of this enumeration should be used alone.
 */
typedef NS_ENUM(NSUInteger, SettingItemType) {
 /** @brief Single page layout button. */
 SINGLE,
 /** @brief Double page layout button. */
 DOUBLEPAGE,
 /** @brief Cover page layout button. */
 COVERPAGE,
 /** @brief Day mode button. */
 DAYMODE,
 /** @brief Page color mode button. */
 PAGECOLOR,
 /** @brief Night mode button. */
 NIGHTMODE,
 /** @brief Continuous page layout button. */
 CONTINUOUS,
 /** @brief Page from right to left button. */
 PAGERTL,
 /** @brief Fitpage button. */
 FITPAGE,
 /** @brief Fitwidth button. */
 FITWIDTH,
 /** @brief Reflow button. */
 REFLOW,
 /** @brief Crop page button. */
 CROPPAGE,
 /** @brief Speak button. */
 SPEECH,
 /** @brief Auto flip button. */
 AUTOFLIP,
 /** @brief rotate button. */
 ROTATE,
 /** @brief Pan&zoom button. */
 PANZOOM,
};
```

```objc
- [FSSettingBar setItem:(SettingItemType)itemType hidden:(BOOL)hidden]
```

1.Hide the "Reflow" item in the View setting bar. (For Phone and Tablet)

Objective-C:
```objc
[self.extensionsMgr.settingBar setItem:REFLOW hidden:YES];
```
Swift:
```swift
extensionsManager.settingBar.setItem(.REFLOW, hidden: true)
```

Customize to hide a specific Panel

You only need to use the following API:

//FSPanelType enum
```objc
/** @brief Panel types. */
typedef NS_ENUM(NSUInteger, FSPanelType) {
 /** @brief Annotation panel type. */
 FSPanelTypeAnnotation = 1,
 /** @brief Attachment panel type. */
 FSPanelTypeAttachment,
 /** @brief Outline panel type. */
 FSPanelTypeOutline,
 /** @brief Reading bookmark panel type. */
 FSPanelTypeReadingBookmark,
 /** @brief Reading digital signature panel type. */
 FSPanelTypeDigitalSignature,
 /** @brief Custom panel type. */
 FSPanelTypeCustom,
};
```
```objc
- [FSPanelController setPanelHidden:(BOOL)isHidden type:(FSPanelType)type];
```

1.Hide the "Outline" panel. (For iPhone and iPad)

Objective-C:
```objc
[self.extensionsMgr.panelController setPanelHidden:true type:FSPanelTypeOutline];
```
Swift:
```objc
extensionsManager.panelController.setPanelHidden(true, type: .outline);
```

---

How to render pages or convert pdf to image.

```objc
// Include Foxit SDK header files.
#import <FoxitRDK/FSPDFObjC.h>
```

```objc
//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static NSString *const sn = @"";
static NSString *const key = @"";

FSErrorCode error_code = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
{
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:@"Sample"];
 [doc load];
 NSArray *support_image_extends = [NSArray arrayWithObjects:@".bmp", @".jpg", @".jpeg", @".png", @".jpx", @".jp2", nil];

 //Get page count
 int page_count = [doc getPageCount];
 for (int i = 0; i < page_count; i++) {
 FSPDFPage *page = [doc getPage:i];
 // Parse page.
 [page startParse:FSPDFPageParsePageNormal pause:nil is_reparse:NO];

 int width = [page getWidth];
 int height = [page getHeight];
 FSMatrix2D *matrix = [page getDisplayMatrix:0 top:0 width:width height:height rotate:[page getRotation]];

 // Prepare a bitmap for rendering.
 FSBitmap *bitmap = [[FSBitmap alloc] initWithWidth:width height:height format:FSBitmapDIBArgb];
 [bitmap fillRect:0xFFFFFFFF];

 // Render page
 FSRenderer *render = [[FSRenderer alloc] initWithBitmap:bitmap is_rgb_order:NO];
 [render startRender:page matrix:matrix];
 }
}
[FSLibrary destroy];
```

---

How to associate file to annotation dictionary?

```objc
// Include Foxit SDK header files.
#import <FoxitRDK/FSPDFObjC.h>
```

```objc
//The correct sn and key must be filled in here
static NSString *const sn = @"";
static NSString *const key = @"";

FSErrorCode error_code = [FSLibrary initialize:sn key:key];
{
 // Load a document
 FSPDFDoc *doc = [[FSPDFDoc alloc] initWithPath:@"sample.pdf"];
 [doc load];

 FSAssociatedFiles *associated_files = [[FSAssociatedFiles alloc] initWithPdf_doc:doc];

 // Create filespec with 1.txt
 FSFileSpec *filespec_txt = [[FSFileSpec alloc] initWithDocument:doc];
 [filespec_txt setAssociteFileRelationship:FSAssociatedFilesRelationshipSource];
 [filespec_txt setFileName:@"1.txt"];
 FSDateTime *dateTime = [[FSDateTime alloc] initWithYear:2017 month:9 day:15 hour:17 minute:20 second:20 milliseconds:0 utc_hour_offset:8 utc_minute_offset:0];
 filespec_txt.description = @"text";
 [filespec_txt embed:@"1.txt"];
 filespec_txt.creationDateTime = dateTime;
 filespec_txt.modifiedDateTime = dateTime;
 filespec_txt.subtype = @"application/octet-stream";

 FSPDFPage *page = [doc getPage:0];
 FSRectF *rect = [[FSRectF alloc] initWithLeft1:100 bottom1:50 right1:220 top1:100];
 FSAnnot *annot = [page addAnnot:FSAnnotNote rect:rect];
 [annot resetAppearanceStream];
 [associated_files associateFileWithAnnot:annot file_spec:filespec_txt];

 // Save PDF file
 [doc saveAs:@"newpdf.pdf" save_flags:FSPDFDocSaveFlagNoOriginal];
}
[FSLibrary destroy];
```
